item.title: dotnet: Announcing .NET 11 Release Candidate 2
item.description:
The .NET 11 Release Candidate 2 release is available. It includes improvements across libraries, runtime, SDK, MSBuild, NuGet, F#, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, and Windows Forms.
